kubejs.ponder.tag.economy.description: Learn all about the SMP economy with this custom made ponder!
kubejs.ponder.admin_shop_guide.text_1: Welcome to the server adminshop/server shop!
kubejs.ponder.admin_shop_guide.text_2: This is a table cloth, right-click them to get a shopping list with the item displayed added to it.
kubejs.ponder.admin_shop_guide.text_3: The adminshop uses Sprockets (¤ 1.00), which you can get from the ATM NPC by withdrawing them from your card.
kubejs.ponder.admin_shop_guide.text_4: Right-click the cashier with the list to get your items delivered onto the belt!
kubejs.ponder.admin_shop_guide.text_5: When you get everything, crouch under the hypertube to get out of the check-out booth! Happy shopping!
kubejs.ponder.bank_card_onboarding.text_: Walk up to a Banker NPC and right-click them using a card to begin. This creates an account and says Bound to {Your username} on the card.
Use the GUI it provides to manage your card.
Depositing takes all coins in your inventory and inputs them into the card you're holding!
Withdrawals take coins out of your card and gives them to you.
You can use the /bal command to see the balance of the card you're holding!
You can add more cards to your account for friends using a blaze banker or right-clicking them to add them to your personal account.
Pro tip! You can have multiple cards at once, just make sure you're holding the right one when the time comes! Have fun!
kubejs.ponder.bank_pay_guide.text_1: Want to send someone some money?
kubejs.ponder.bank_pay_guide.text_3: Just hold a card to transfer the money out of and do the command!
kubejs.ponder.bank_pay_guide.text_4: If the receiver is holding a card at the time, the money goes right into that account! If not, they get it in physical coins.
kubejs.ponder.bank_pay_guide.text_5: Quick note, you can't pay yourself to avoid breaking the purpose of the Bank!
kubejs.ponder.bank_pay_guide.text_6: If you have ideas/suggestions for new features or for these tutorials, make a suggestion on the discord! Happy banking!
kubejs.ponder.player_shop_guide.text_1: Want something to do with all of your factories?
kubejs.ponder.player_shop_guide.text_2: The SMP actually has a simple and effective player shops at spawn system!
kubejs.ponder.player_shop_guide.text_3: Just head over to our discord and fill out the Shop Plot Owner application in #support-and-jobs!
kubejs.ponder.player_shop_guide.text_4: Then when accepted, you must hold a card tied to the account you want to use for rent payments at the time we buy it for you.
kubejs.ponder.player_shop_guide.text_5: We use discord to keep things organized and to avoid people abusing the system. Just as an FYI
kubejs.ponder.player_shop_guide.text_6: That's it! Read the message before starting the application for info on prices! Have fun with your shop!
